summary: Set Array length while preserving validation, truncation, and sparse growth semantics.

target.notes: Validate the assigned value according to ArraySetLength. Shrinking deletes own elements at or above the new length; growing creates holes rather than undefined elements.

caveats: Non-configurable indexed elements require the full ArraySetLength failure/rollback algorithm and are excluded here.
Fractional, NaN, infinite, negative, and >=2^32 invalid lengths throw RangeError.

tests.name: shrink truncates
tests.input: const a=[1,2,3]; a.length=1; console.log(a.length,a[1],1 in a);

tests.name: grow creates holes
tests.input: const a=[1]; a.length=3; console.log(a.length,1 in a,a[1]);

tests.name: invalid fractional length throws
tests.input: try { const a=[]; a.length=1.5; } catch(e) { console.log(e.name); }
